description:
Save a manually managed contact for calls, texts or email.

        The contact appears in workspace contact searches and can be selected
        for call handover if it has a phone number, or an extension on a call
        to a connected number. A duplicate phone or email returns 409.

email.description: The address to email this contact at, such as ``ana@example.com``. Give this, ``phone_e164``, ``extension``, or several.
email.title: Email

extension.description: Extension on the workspace's connected phone system (1 to 6 digits, * or #), such as ``800`` for a support queue. Used for handover on calls to a connected number.
extension.title: Extension

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

phone_e164.description: Number used to call or text the contact. A contact can be reachable by phone, email, or both.
phone_e164.title: Phone E164

name: create_contact

email.description: Email address. Null if none on file.
email.title: Email

extension.description: Extension on your connected phone system. Null if none on file.
extension.title: Extension

phone_e164.description: Phone number, E.164 format. Null if none on file.
phone_e164.title: Phone E164

role.description: Manual contacts have no workspace role.

title: Create a contact
